typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DeltaDate as timestamp (),
	EmailRecipientsCC as string (),
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	ErrorEmailRecipientsCC as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FilePath as string (),
	File_IID as integer (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	QueryEndDate as timestamp (),
	QueryStartDate as timestamp (),
	RecordsInSrcFile as integer (),
	StartDate as timestamp (),
	TimeStamp as string ()
}

source(output(
		sbscrbrId as string,
		currentAdvocate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileNurseDetails
FlatFileNurseDetails derive(Create_Date = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileNurseDetails aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		CAREGUIDE_ND_SubscriberID as string,
		CAREGUIDE_ND_USDomainID as string,
		CAREGUIDE_ND_Create_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CAREGUIDE_ND_SubscriberID = sbscrbrId,
		CAREGUIDE_ND_USDomainID = currentAdvocate,
		CAREGUIDE_ND_Create_Date = Create_Date)) ~> PDSCAREGUIDEMEMBERSTAGING
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
